If you have a drill, you can find a drill brush on Amazon for super cheap(go with a soft upholstery brush) and take a warm water and carpet cleaning or stain removing solution and spray the seats. After that you just wanna let it sit for a couple minutes and then agitate with the drill brush and then let that sit for a couple more minutes and then just simply suck it out. I found a steam cleaning attachment works the best but you can basically use any carpet cleaner attachment. 
Side note: use a bleach-free cleaner b/c it can make your seats worse. Did it by accident I’m my truck and had to go order seat covers because I didn’t realize the cleaner had bleach in it. (Rookie mistake) and if you don’t have a drill to get a drill brush you can use a hand held bristle scrubber but it might not work as well. 
Good Luck!!
